$comment: The teaching units and every question that belongs to each, transcribed or not (#2868 Addition A, ADR-W-208). Dates: the operator's roadmap calendar (30 Oct 2026). Questions: assigned by a session from docs/sample questions/ on 2026-11-13. member = the repo transcription a measure replays; null = not transcribed yet. scripts/ops/readiness.mjs measures it into ops/readiness.json.
note: Made 2026-11-13 by reading every question of the 572 Logify booklet (16 exams, 2021–2025: Q1 analytic, Q2 3-D vectors, Q3 complex — all 48 enumerated; Q4+ are calculus, skipped), all 40 exercises on the 10 ellipse-book pages, and the 471 inventory (46 questions, Q4–Q5 of 23 exams). Skipped as out of scope: the 571 booklet (5-unit first paper: plane geometry, trig, sequences, probability, calculus — no analytic/vectors/complex; not opened page by page), the summer worksheet (calculus, plane geometry, trig — TOC checked), the screenshots and WhatsApp images (2-D plane geometry / trig). Unit assignment of 572 Q1 is by what the question mainly needs; a question needing both ellipse and parabola sits in parabola (the later unit). Questions with a note field say where a part belongs elsewhere. locus is thin (2 questions): the 572 booklet has no pure locus question; the locus parts of 572/7, 10, 14 sit in ellipse/parabola. The book the class uses for locus (and for parabola) is not in docs/sample questions — those exercises are missing, not omitted. lines-circles holds 44 of the 46 corpus471 entries (4/5 and 5/4 are pure synthetic plane geometry, dropped), plus 572/6 and two operator exam questions. 471 is the 4-unit booklet; whether it is the class booklet for this unit is unconfirmed. member: corpus471/corpus572 → the entry in src-analytic/__tests__/fixtures/corpus{471,572}.json by id (green = derive(confirmTaught(lines)) with no faults, as the ratchet tests measure). fixture → that file (green = the builder's fixtures net replays it clean). test → a test file (and describe name) that replays the question; it has no per-question verdict file, so a script must run that describe. otherMembers lists further fixtures for the same question (parts, wordings); a question should count green only when member and every otherMember are green — to be decided. A member often covers only some parts (see note): a green member means those parts build, not the whole question. Complex members are part-א only. Members matched by content rather than by an exam-marked name (3-D 572/2, 572/15, 572/10; complex 572/10) are confidence medium and fall outside the EXAM_NAME corpus filter. Not listed: the complex corpus exams sampled in docs/archive/27 (2020 קיץ, 2018, 2015, 2013, 2011) — not in the booklets and with no fixture.
